Resuming the backend build. Foundation milestone (A) now validated end to end: prisma schema pushed to SQLite (fixed an invalid onDelete:SetNull on OrderItem.product — required FK can't SetNull, dropped to default), seed ran clean (48 products, 7 users incl. demo alex@demo.com, 2 demo orders), and GET /api/health returns {status:ok, database:up, provider:sqlite, products:48, users:7}. Next: commit milestone A with the agent log, then build the auth API (register/login/logout/me on DB sessions with guest support).
(task #2) Auth API: register/login/logout/me with DB sessions

Auth API done and verified by curl: register 201, duplicate 409 EMAIL_TAKEN, bad login 401, login sets httpOnly sid cookie and returns user with addresses, /me reflects session, logout clears it, zod validation returns issue details. Hit one bug: CartItem.userId was required so guest carts could not exist — reshaped to dual-owner (optional userId OR sessionId, both unique constraints) with merge-on-login in lib/server/cart.ts. Also fixed a route import depth bug (5 levels of ../ instead of 4) that 500'd every auth route on first compile.

Catalog + reviews API verified: GET /api/products with q search (case-insensitive JS filter after provider-safe Prisma where — keeps SQLite/Postgres identical), category/flag/price filters, 5 sort orders, pagination envelope {products,total,page,pages}; GET /api/products/[id]; GET reviews w/ 4 sorts; POST review requires auth, 409 on duplicate, recomputes product rating+reviewCount from aggregate; POST /api/reviews/[id]/helpful increments. Added Review type to types/index.ts. Noted toProduct omits stock (server-only concern).
